summary: Phase 32 — Claros Core (Campus ERP) end-to-end testing. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases PASS covering all 17 /api/v1/core/* endpoints + 6 authorisation 403 cases + multi-tenant seed verification across ISB/EAIC/UoB + NEXUS legacy regression + Phase 31 AI regression. STUDENT flows 12/14 PASS — dashboard donut visible & KPI strip correctly hidden, timetable grid renders, fees components/summary visible, notice new btn correctly hidden, attendance-mark denied msg renders. rca_of_the_issue: Student attendance report empty table RCA: ClarosCoreAttendanceReport.jsx most likely uses a single fetch path (GET /v1/core/attendance/report) for both admin and student roles. The backend explicitly rewrites the filter when user.role==='student' to scope to their own student_id (routes_core.py L315-320), which would normally succeed — but the page may also pass admin-only query params (iid/date filters) or render the table conditionally on response shape and skip rendering on a 403. The cleanest fix is: if role==='student', call GET /v1/core/attendance/summary/me (returns {per_course[], overall}) and render per_course directly; that endpoint is already tested green.
